Sofia (Support): FYI, customer ACME-233 reporting p95 ~700ms for text-generation. They say they pin to eu-west-1 but traces show a lot of hits to us-west-2. Can someone look? @Alex K
ops-bot: config-update detected: /failover/policies/acme-233.json updated by jared at 2026-08-04T15:02:11Z
Alex K (SRE): grabbing logs. do we have the failover policy file from the customer's org? can you paste it, Sofia?
Sofia (Support): pasted below (redacted keys). customer said change happened after onboarding yesterday. here's the raw header from their failing request:```
X-Request-Id: req_01H
X-Client-Region: eu-west-1
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
```
but router trace shows: ``router/choose -> selected_region=us-west-2, reason=policy_order``
Jared (Runtime): I pulled the policy from S3. quick look: the yaml got reordered during the last commit. showing the section:
```
failover:
  - region: us-west-2
    priority: 1
    weight: "0.9"
    sticky: true
  - region: eu-west-1
    priority: 2
    weight: "0.1"
    sticky: true
```
Jared (Runtime): That is the file deployed. The intention was eu-west-1 primary but the list here makes us-west-2 priority 1. Looks like a deploy-time transform inverted the array order.
Alex K (SRE): ok that explains selection. why did we not respect the client's pin header? sticky is true, but sticky only affects session affinity after initial selection. initial selection is entirely policy-driven.
Sofia (Support): customer also included a cURL reproducer:```
curl -v -H "X-Client-Region: eu-west-1" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
and they included a tracer snippet (timestamps): ``req_start=15:04:12.330, router_choose=15:04:12.331, upstream_connect_us-west-2=15:04:12.335``
Alex K (SRE): two quick notes: 1) weight values stored as strings are fine, our parser coerces them; the real problem is list order. 2) We should confirm whether the deploy transform reversed arrays when converting from TOML->JSON (we had a bug around stable-sort in the transformer).
Jared (Runtime): I reproduced locally by running the transformer on their original file; arrays were reversed due to a dependency bump in the YAML library. Patch incoming.
Alex K (SRE): mitigation plan: 1) push a hotfix to transform to preserve order, 2) manually correct the customer's policy on config service and restart router for that org only (no global restart), 3) roll a canary of the transformer fix and re-run on a small set of orgs that had recent updates.
Sofia (Support): customer asked about billing — they saw higher token costs because requests hit a more expensive region. can we confirm cost delta and include that in the apology?
Jared (Runtime): yes I'll add cost delta calc. quick grep of router logs shows ~82% of their requests went to us-west-2 after the update window between 15:00-16:00 UTC.
Alex K (SRE): repro steps recorded: 1) take original policy file, run current transformer, observe array reversed, 2) deploy reversed policy to a staging router, 3) send request with X-Client-Region header, observe selection goes to first item in list -> us-west-2.
Sofia (Support): customer is asking for ETA. can we give an eta for the fix + rollback?
Jared (Runtime): deploying manual rollback for acme-233 now (patch config + reload). should be live in ~8 minutes. I'll follow up when reload finishes.
ops-bot: config-reload success: /failover/policies/acme-233.json reloaded at 2026-08-04T15:11:09Z by jared
Jared (Runtime): reload complete. verified with trace: router/choose -> selected_region=eu-west-1, reason=policy_order. p95 dropped from ~700ms to ~120ms for the sampled requests.
Alex K (SRE): leaving postmortem task: - fix transformer dependency and add unit test for array stability - add validation check on deploy that warns if the intended primary region differs from first list element - notify billing ops for possible credit
Sofia (Support): I'll update the customer: rolled back, latency normalized, we're pushing a permanent fix and billing ops will review. apologizing and offering transient credits. :pray:
Jared (Runtime): adding the PR link in case you want to review: https://git.redwood/inference/transformer/pull/412
Sofia (Support): thanks all. closing once billing confirms credit decision.
